en: The postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of a landscaped terrace with balustrades, stairs, and lush trees, overlooking a bay with ships in the water. The reverse side contains handwritten text in Cyrillic, a Bulgarian postage stamp from the Kingdom of Bulgaria period, and printed lines for correspondence. Printed text in both Cyrillic (Bulgarian) and German identifies the city as Varna (Warna) and describes the subject as 'the steps near the baths.'
